scope: Fix fullscreen text blur (P0, user-reported: text blurry fullscreen, crisp windowed). Root cause: project.binary has no display/window/stretch/mode (defaults to disabled), game renders at 1280x800 and pixel-stretches to 2560x1440 fullscreen (non-integer 2.0x/1.8x) -> blur. Windowed 1:1 is crisp. Fix: at runtime in GameState._ready() call get_tree().set_screen_stretch(SceneTree.STRETCH_MODE_2D, SceneTree.STRETCH_ASPECT_KEEP, Vector2(1280,800), 1.0) so Godot 3.5 re-rasterizes DynamicFont text via font oversampling at the actual screen size (STRETCH_MODE_2D), keeping CJK and Latin crisp in fullscreen.

entities.expected_runtime_effect: Godot 3.5 autoload _ready() runs after the engine's own set_screen_stretch (scene_tree.cpp _update_root_rect + font oversampling), so calling set_screen_stretch(STRETCH_MODE_2D=1, STRETCH_ASPECT_KEEP=1, Vector2(1280,800), 1.0) overrides the disabled default and re-rasterizes DynamicFont glyphs at fullscreen scale via _update_font_oversampling(screen/viewport)

patches.new_text:
func _ready():
				print("GameState getting ready...")
				randomize()
				get_tree().set_screen_stretch(SceneTree.STRETCH_MODE_2D, SceneTree.STRETCH_ASPECT_KEEP, Vector2(1280, 800), 1.0)

not_proven: visual sharpness at every fullscreen resolution, DPI virtualization behavior, gameplay, release readiness
